description: Onboarding journeys from the 2026-09-08 MCP field audit (typed) and the four shipped MCP prompt playbooks (selected with invoke), pinned to the synthetic fixture. A journey with expectedWrite authorizes exactly that transaction and any listed directives; every other journey is read-only. confirmationTurn marks the follow-up that approves a write, and nothing may be written before it. Every expected value is derived from fixtures/main.bean and re-derived independently by scripts/__tests__/mcp-agent-eval.test.ts; change both together.

journeys.title: Cash balance, August food spending, then one authorized cash purchase
journeys.prompt: My Beancount ledger is {ledger} on the beancount MCP server. What is my Assets:Cash balance before any change, and how much did I spend on food (all Expenses:Food accounts together) in August 2026? Then record exactly one purchase: on 2026-08-31 I paid 4.50 USD in cash at BLUE BOTTLE for coffee, booked to Expenses:Food:Coffee. You are authorized to make that single write and nothing else. Reply with the cash balance, the August food total, and whether the purchase was recorded.

facts.description: Assets:Cash balance before the purchase
August 2026 spending across Expenses:Food

journeys.title: August spending report, net worth, stale accounts, and validity
journeys.prompt: My Beancount ledger is {ledger} on the beancount MCP server. Do not change the ledger. For August 2026, give me a spending report: total expenses and the amount for each expense account. What is my net worth (all assets plus liabilities)? Which accounts had no postings at all in the 90 days before 2026-08-31? Does the ledger balance, or does it have validation errors?

facts.description: Total August 2026 expenses
August 2026 amount per expense account
Net worth across assets and liabilities
Accounts without postings in the 90 days before 2026-08-31
The ledger has no validation errors

journeys.title: Ledger discovery, five most recent transactions, and payees
journeys.prompt: Do not change any ledger. Which Beancount ledgers can I access on the beancount MCP server? In the ledger you find, list the five most recent transactions with their date, payee, and amount, and then list every payee that appears in the ledger.

facts.description: The accessible ledger is named
